name: Sales credit administration
summary: What Track3D Sales do on the credit model: create progress projects from order forms, override the pool, approve size corrections, move existing companies in, convert projects, and watch companies on the Sales credit pages. Work in progress: only on the feature/progress-linked-credit branches, not on track-3d.

roles.note: Every action here is for Track3D Sales: the Sales system role, or an email on an allowlist kept by support admins. That is not a catalog permission, so it is shown as support-user conditional. Customers have no access.

requirements.title: Progress projects are created only by Sales, above a minimum size
requirements.statement: Once the credit model is live, only Sales can create a progress project, from an order form or the Sales form, and only at or above the progress minimum site area. Customers who try are asked to contact Sales. Everything else a customer creates is a visual project.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (constructn-api@984e5354512a); not on track-3d. Today customers with create-project can create progress projects themselves (PROJ-FEAT-01).

requirements.title: Sales may allow a visual project beyond the pool
requirements.statement: When creating or approving a visual project, Sales may go beyond the company's available credit by giving a reason. The pool is used first; the excess is logged as an override with the reason. An override is also the only way to create a visual project for a company with no active progress project.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, constructn-api@984e5354512a); not on track-3d.

requirements.title: An enterprise admin's size change to a progress project waits for Sales
requirements.statement: When anyone other than Sales changes a progress project's site area, the project keeps its old size and the change becomes a pending correction for Sales. If Sales approve, the project's size and its credit (five times the new area) change; if they reject, nothing changes. Sales' own size and date changes apply straight away. One pending correction per project; it is dropped if the project's credit expires.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (constructn-api@984e5354512a, project-api@0b8add5cbba5); not on track-3d.

requirements.title: Sales can move an existing company into the credit model
requirements.statement: Sales can preview and then move an existing company into the credit model, choosing which of its progress projects earn credit. Each chosen project must be approved, have a square-foot size, a start date and duration, and not have ended. Its credit runs to its existing end date. The company's existing visual projects are grandfathered and use no credit. The move is one-way, and moved companies are not held to the minimum sizes.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, db-models@39f53b96975a); not on track-3d.

requirements.title: Converting a project between progress and visual never reuses credit
requirements.statement: Sales can convert a project on the credit model between progress and visual. Visual to progress: the credit it used stays used, and it earns new progress credit like any approved progress project (it must meet the progress minimum). Progress to visual: its unused credit expires at once and it carries on as a paid visual-only project. Visual projects that drew from it are unaffected.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, constructn-api@984e5354512a); not on track-3d.

requirements.title: Paid visual-only projects are built but switched off
requirements.statement: Sales can sell a visual project on its own order form that neither uses nor earns credit, at or above a separate visual-only minimum size. This is switched off by a separate setting until its price is confirmed. While off, every visual project Sales create uses credit like any other.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, constructn-api@984e5354512a); not on track-3d.

requirements.title: Prices are shown for information; payment is offline
requirements.statement: Each kind of project (progress, visual-only) has a fixed price per square foot, a minimum size and a credit multiplier, the same for every company and contract. The Sales form shows the price and, for progress projects, the credit it will add. The platform takes no payment and issues no invoice. Changing a price needs a release.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (db-models@39f53b96975a, track3d-web@af7f2c449f38); not on db-models master or track3d-web main. Figures are deliberately not copied here.

requirements.title: Sales credit pages
requirements.statement: Sales have a credit list of companies on the model (available, starting later, active progress projects, credit expiring within 30 days, pending corrections), a company page (each progress project's lot, each visual project and which progress projects funded it), the company's ledger, pending corrections, notifications and a list of companies blocked for lack of credit, as sales leads.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, track3d-web@af7f2c449f38); not on track-3d or track3d-web main.
